RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the December 22, 2008/Pausa 1, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
96
Regulations for admission and fee
structure of universities and colleges
*281. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee, constituted
by the University Grants Commission
(UGC), to prepare draft regulations for
admission and fee structure in self-financing
universities and colleges, has submitted its
report;
(b) if so,  what are the recommendations
made by the Committee;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Central
Advisory Board on Education (CABE)
Committee on financing of higher education
has also given some recommendations with
regard to the fee structure; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Literacy rate of women
*282. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the overall literacy rate of
women in the country, State-wise;
(b) what is the overall literacy rate of
the rural population of women in the
country, State-wise;
(c) what are the main causes of illiteracy
among the rural population of the country;
(d) what steps are being taken to
improve the literacy rate among women in
the country, for betterment of the society;
and
(e) whether Government is planning to
launch any special programmes to improve
the situation, and if so, the details thereof?
Role of public and private sectors in
power generation and distribution
*283. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether, emphasizing the increased
role for the public sector in power
generation and the private sector in the
distribution business, he has decided to
strengthen technological and managerial
expertise of Public Sector  Undertakings
(PSUs) in power sector and synergize their

97
roles, to complement generation capacity
building efforts;
(b) if so, what are the main suggestions
made to the PSUs in the power sector;
(c) how many of these suggestions have
been considered by those PSUs; and
(d) to what extent the power generation
targets would be achieved during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan?
Opening of Kendriya Vidyalayas
*284. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to open more Kendriya Vidyalayas, and if
so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether in view of direct investment
or industrialization of Kalinganagar-Jajpur
Road in Jajpur District of Orissa,
Government has any plan to open a
Kendriya Vidyalaya at Vyasanagar, Jajpur
Road?
Misuse of laws by women
*285. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the laws enacted for the safety of women,
viz. Dowry Prohibition Act; Protection of
Women from Domestic Violence Act etc.
are being misused by women against their
husbands and in-laws, to mint money and
to harass them;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
stop such maltreatment of husbands and
their families by their spouses;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
enact a law, on the lines of the above laws,
to save husbands and their families from
their spouses;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, whether Government would
take  some action to enact such a law?
Output of Dabhol Power Project
*286. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:L
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) why the power output from the
erstwhile Dabhol Power Project is
continuing to be erratic; and
(b) by when it would be fully
operational?
Streamlining procedure for cooked
meals to children
*287. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has recently
constituted a Group of Ministers (GoM)
to recommend a procedure, by which all
the country's Anganwadis and Government
sponsored childcare centres would provide
cooked meals to children under the
Integrated Child Development Services
(ICDS) Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the GoM has been asked to
consult  State Governments also in this
regard; and
(d) if so, by when it is likely to submit
its report to Government?

large number of children in India, mostly in
all the metropolitan cities, and particularly
in Delhi, are staying on the roadside and
selling things at the traffic signals;
